title: A Echo for the Orbit
author: I. M. Yarrow
blurb: Ada Dunmore, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
